title: E-MTR-0029: explores whether the light register pair disperses relativistically along its whole curve and whether...
purpose: Experiment E-MTR-0029 in the spin arena: explores whether the light register pair disperses relativistically along its whole curve and whether its internal clock dilates with its centre-of-mass motion (quadrature): the $a_B$ 8 pair with the contact well removed boosted to K 0.04 to 1.6, against the lone member's own lattice band: fail, from K 0.4 up the levels mix with lines closer than the read's resolution, so neither is measured.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
